title: The Two Gardens
source_detail: For whoever fears the standing before their Lord are two gardens — generosity and sharing what we love
description: Two neighbors each tend a beautiful garden. One keeps all its fruit for himself; the other shares with every visitor. A warm story about the joy that comes from open-handed giving.

pages.text: Far away, nestled between rolling green hills and a sparkling river, lay a cheerful village. Two houses, side-by-side, each boasted a magnificent garden. Sunlight always seemed to dance on their colorful flowers and ripe, juicy fruits. It was a truly lovely place to live.
pages.illustration_prompt: Wide shot of a cheerful, sunlit village with two distinct houses. Lush green hills in the background, a sparkling river winding nearby. The foreground shows a glimpse of two vibrant gardens. The overall mood is warm, inviting, and magical. Color palette: lush greens, warm golds, deep blues.

pages.text: One garden belonged to Mr. Grumbles. Oh, his garden was a wonder! Rows of plump tomatoes, trees heavy with shining apples, and bushes laden with berries. He spent every day making sure it was perfect, without a single leaf out of place.
pages.illustration_prompt: Mr. Grumbles, a man with a slightly serious but not unkind expression, stands proudly in his perfectly manicured garden. Rows of vibrant red tomatoes and apple trees heavy with shining red fruits are visible. He's alone, admiring his work. The colors are rich and detailed.

pages.text: Mr. Grumbles loved his garden more than anything. He loved watching his fruits grow big and bright. But mostly, he loved keeping them all to himself. He would pick them carefully and store them away, never sharing a single one.
pages.illustration_prompt: Close-up of Mr. Grumbles' hands carefully picking a perfectly ripe, shining apple from a tree. His expression is one of possessive satisfaction. A woven basket sits beside him, already half-full of beautiful, untouched fruit. Sunlight filters through the leaves.

pages.text: The garden next door belonged to Mr. Smiles. His garden was just as beautiful, bursting with every color imaginable! Sweet-smelling roses climbed trellises, and plump pumpkins nestled amongst sprawling vines. Bees buzzed happily among the blossoms.
pages.illustration_prompt: Mr. Smiles, a kind-looking man with a warm, gentle smile, stands in his equally vibrant garden. It looks a little more wild and abundant than Mr. Grumbles's, with colorful flowers, pumpkins, and trellises covered in climbing roses. Bees are gently buzzing. Mood is joyful and inviting.

pages.text: Mr. Smiles also loved his garden dearly. But his joy came from a different place. He believed that the fruits of his garden were a gift from Allah, meant to be shared with everyone who visited, big or small.
pages.illustration_prompt: Mr. Smiles, with a beaming smile, hands a small, overflowing basket of freshly picked, ripe berries (strawberries, blueberries) to a small child with big, happy, expressive eyes. The child is reaching eagerly. Lush green leaves and rich berry colors dominate the scene.

pages.text: Children from the village knew that a visit to Mr. Smiles’ garden always meant a happy surprise. They loved to help him gather berries or find the ripest peaches. Their laughter often filled the air, a cheerful melody.
pages.illustration_prompt: Two to three children (ages 6-8) happily playing and picking berries near a fruit tree in Mr. Smiles' garden. Mr. Smiles is gently supervising, smiling. One child holds a small bucket of berries. The scene is full of bright colors and joyful energy. Visible brushstrokes add texture.

pages.text: "Please, have some of these juicy peaches!" Mr. Smiles would say, his eyes twinkling. "They taste even sweeter when shared with a friend. There is always more than enough for everyone."
pages.illustration_prompt: Close-up of Mr. Smiles offering a perfectly ripe, fuzzy peach to a child. The child's eyes are wide with delight. Sunlight streams through the leaves of the peach tree, creating a warm, golden glow. The background is softly blurred, focusing on the interaction.

pages.text: From his own quiet garden, Mr. Grumbles would sometimes peek over the fence. He saw the happy faces and heard the laughter. But he didn't quite understand the joy that came from giving away his precious fruit.
pages.illustration_prompt: Mr. Grumbles' face is partially visible as he peers out from behind a bush or from his window, looking towards Mr. Smiles' vibrant garden. His expression is one of mild curiosity mixed with a touch of bewilderment. In the background, children are faintly visible playing and laughing.

pages.text: One sunny morning, Mr. Grumbles spotted a cheeky little bird flitting amongst his cherry tree. It was pecking at his prize, bright red cherries! He felt a frown spread across his face.
pages.illustration_prompt: A small, colorful bird (e.g., a robin or finch) is perched on a branch in Mr. Grumbles' cherry tree, happily pecking at a bright red cherry. Mr. Grumbles is in the background, looking distressed and slightly annoyed, making a shooing motion with his hand.

pages.text: "Shoo, shoo! Those are *my* cherries!" he grumbled, waving his arms. The bird, startled, flew away with a flutter of wings, leaving him alone with his perfect, untouched fruit.
pages.illustration_prompt: Close-up of Mr. Grumbles' face, showing a slightly cross and possessive expression. His hand is still raised as if shooing. The small bird is a blur in the background, flying away from his garden. The cherries remain on the tree, untouched by the bird.

pages.text: Later, Mr. Grumbles saw the very same bird. This time, it was happily pecking at berries in Mr. Smiles' garden! Mr. Smiles was nearby, watering his plants, and simply smiled at the little visitor.
pages.illustration_prompt: The same small, colorful bird is now contentedly pecking at ripe berries in Mr. Smiles' garden. Mr. Smiles is in the background, tending to a plant with a watering can, a gentle, understanding smile on his face as he watches the bird. The mood is peaceful and accepting.

pages.text: Mr. Grumbles couldn't help himself. He walked to the low fence between their gardens. "Doesn't it bother you, brother?" he asked, a hint of surprise in his voice. "That bird is eating your precious fruit!"
pages.illustration_prompt: Mr. Grumbles is peeking over a low wooden fence, his expression a mix of curiosity and confusion, addressing Mr. Smiles. Mr. Smiles is turned towards him, holding a small trowel or watering can, looking calm and friendly.

pages.text: Mr. Smiles chuckled softly. "Oh no, my dear brother! There is enough for all of Allah's creatures in this wide world. And it brings me a special kind of joy to see them happy and well-fed."
pages.illustration_prompt: Mr. Smiles is looking kindly at Mr. Grumbles, gesturing with an open hand towards his abundant garden. A small squirrel is visible scampering up a tree or a butterfly fluttering by, adding to the sense of shared bounty. The sun shines warmly.

pages.text: Mr. Grumbles stood silently, thinking about Mr. Smiles' words. He looked back at his own garden, at his perfect, untouched fruits. They were beautiful, yes, but they felt a little lonely, somehow.
pages.illustration_prompt: Mr. Grumbles stands thoughtfully in his own garden, looking at his perfect, untouched fruits. His expression is pensive, a hint of realization dawning on his face. The garden, while beautiful, feels slightly empty compared to Mr. Smiles' lively one.

pages.text: He remembered the bright, happy faces of the children in Mr. Smiles' garden. He remembered the contented bird. A new feeling, like a tiny spark, began to glow softly in his heart.
pages.illustration_prompt: A soft, slightly dreamy illustration showing a composite of happy children laughing and playing, and the content bird peacefully eating, as if these images are floating gently in Mr. Grumbles' mind. The background is warm and slightly blurred, representing thought.

pages.text: The very next morning, a little girl with big, curious eyes paused by Mr. Grumbles' fence. She gazed longingly at a ripe, purple fig hanging low on a branch, just out of her reach.
pages.illustration_prompt: A small girl with big, expressive, curious eyes stands outside Mr. Grumbles' fence, looking up with wonder at a perfectly ripe, purple fig hanging on a tree. The fig is prominent and tempting. The fence is a simple wooden one.

pages.text: Mr. Grumbles was nearby, watering his roses. He saw the girl's hopeful face. A warm feeling spread through him, and without a second thought, he picked the juicy fig. "Would you like this, dear?" he asked, a small, new smile forming on his face.
pages.illustration_prompt: Mr. Grumbles, with a gentle and slightly shy smile, is offering the ripe purple fig to the surprised and delighted little girl. His hand is extended, and her eyes are wide with happiness. The sun illuminates the scene warmly.

pages.text: The girl's eyes lit up like two bright stars. "Oh, thank you, sir!" she chirped, carefully taking the fig. As she skipped away, Mr. Grumbles felt a warmth spread through him, sweeter than any fruit from his garden.
pages.illustration_prompt: Close-up of the little girl's hands happily accepting the fig from Mr. Grumbles. Her face is full of pure joy and gratitude. Mr. Grumbles watches her with a truly happy, open expression, feeling a warmth in his chest. Bright, joyful colors.

pages.text: Soon, both gardens were places of laughter, generosity, and sharing. Mr. Grumbles still loved his perfect fruits, but now he loved sharing them even more. He knew the *real* garden was the one in his heart, blooming with kindness.
pages.illustration_prompt: Both gardens are now vibrant, lush, and full of life. Children are happily playing and interacting in both gardens. Mr. Smiles and Mr. Grumbles are seen together, sharing fruits with the children, both smiling warmly. A visible sense of community and joy pervades the scene.

pages.text: Just as Allah promises two beautiful gardens for those who remember Him and strive for goodness, one of joy in this world, and one in the Hereafter. May your own heart be a garden of generosity, filled with peace and warmth as you close your eyes and drift to sleep.
pages.illustration_prompt: A peaceful, calming sunset scene over the harmonious, combined gardens. The colors are soft oranges, pinks, and deep blues. In the foreground, a child (the listener) is gently falling asleep in a cozy bed, bathed in soft, warm light from a nearby window. A subtle starry sky or moon is visible through the window, creating a serene, goodnight atmosphere.
